description: t.a reserves two obligations, commits the first, and is cancelled at 50 while it sleeps. Its cleanup, which runs after the acknowledgement, aborts the second (reason Cancel) before the task ends: both leave Reserved (one Committed, one Aborted), none leaks, the ledger is empty and the run is quiescent (PROG-OBLIGATION: an owner that commits or aborts resolves its obligation, even when cancelled).
